prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the attached AgentHarbor simplified desktop chat mockup into a beautifully polished BLACK / CHARCOAL professional desktop developer tool. The user explicitly wants a black-background tool and further visual refinement. Keep the simplified THREE-pane conversation-first information architecture and all functional content. This must be a convincing mature desktop application, not a website, not a flashy sci-fi dashboard, not a simple color inversion.

COMPOSITION: one complete 1536x1024 native Windows desktop app window. Single compact dark native title bar, AgentHarbor at upper left with a small simple sailboat mark, clearly visible small “设计预览 · 示例数据” label, Windows minimize/maximize/close controls at upper right. No Mac traffic lights, browser frame or decorative surroundings. Three stable independently scrolling panes, left project/meetings sidebar about 240px, wide dominant center conversation, right task inspector about 320px. Keep the restrained sparse content and collapse secondary details. Add no fourth rail, no menu strip, no metrics, extra cards, member grids or added navigation.

BLACK SURFACE DESIGN: center conversation ground #101214, left sidebar #14171B, right task inspector #16191D, title bar #0D0F12, message composer #1B1F25. Use subtle neighboring charcoal values to separate areas, just 1px dividers #292E36 where necessary. Main text is warm off-white #E7EBF0, secondary text #ACB5C2, subtle text still legible #929CAA. Very restrained cool blue #85A9FF for links and selection; primary Send button a refined medium blue #457BEB with crisp white text. Amber #E3AD62 only for the incomplete task and blocker. No pure-white panels, no bright saturated sidebar, no neon, gradients, glows, frosted glass, decorative shadows or textured background. Dark surface choices must appear considered rather than the white mockup inverted.

TYPOGRAPHY AND DETAIL: one excellent neutral modern sans-serif with crisp Chinese glyphs; body comfortable around 17px at 1440 width, author names 16px medium, room heading 21px semibold, right-task heading 19px medium; 14px readable metadata. Smaller and more sophisticated than the large heavy text in the reference, but never faint or tiny. Use consistent 8px spacing rhythm, 24–32px group spacing, clear control hit areas, fine 8–10px control radii; panels have no outer cards. Avatars are modest 30px circles, muted steel-blue/charcoal, consistent letter initials. Small consistent outlined icon set. The screen should have the visual care of a premium desktop coding/chat tool.

LEFT: a compact project dropdown “harbor-web” under a quiet “项目” label. One understated outline “+ 新建会议” button. “最近会议” followed by only three rows: “登录重试修复”, “优化任务恢复”, “新增助手接入”. Active row has a subtle blue-charcoal fill #222D40 and off-white text, not a huge electric blue slab. Bottom links only “助手管理” and “设置”. Avoid excessive boxing around the project selector or button.

CENTER: header “登录重试修复” left and compact “3 位助手” control right. The conversation is the primary visual area, with a consistent vertical author/content rhythm. Four readable messages:
主持人 “先修复登录过期后的重试问题，验证后由 Claude Code 审核。”
Codex · 执行 “刷新逻辑已修复，现有 8 项回归测试通过。”
Below Codex show just “查看改动” and “查看测试” as small blue inline links, no evidence cards.
Claude Code · 审核 “还缺少并发重试用例，暂不通过。”
主持人 “已交回 Codex 补测，完成后自动再次审核。”
Use almost-flat dark message backgrounds only where they improve grouping; do not wrap every paragraph in a big bubble or colored panel. The reviewer message may have a very subtle warm-dark treatment, no bright warning card. A quiet inline progress line “Codex 正在补充测试…” follows the last message. Natural breathing room below, not additional fake controls. Fixed composer at center bottom: dark raised surface with one subtle outline, placeholder “描述目标，或 @助手加入讨论…”, attachment icon at lower left and a modest blue “发送” button lower right. No toolbar crowding, recipient dropdown or duplicate task tag.

RIGHT: heading “当前任务”, a small amber “补测中” status, task title “补充并发重试用例”, and muted “执行：Codex”. Next group “下一步” with “重新测试，再交由 Claude Code 审核”. Next group “待解决” with a subtle dark-amber callout “并发重试尚未验证” and a small warning icon. Below, three collapsed disclosure rows only: “验收标准”, “改动与测试”, “执行历史”. No visible checklists, patch cards, timestamps, activity timeline or repeat participant list. At bottom a quiet outlined “暂停任务” button. Keep the visible unfinished state truthful.

The final image should feel calm, precise, dark, refined and unmistakably a practical desktop tool. Maintain readable contrast and the task-first hierarchy. All sample data remains clearly labeled as a design preview, not real execution.
userFeedback: Further refine the visual appearance; prefer a black-background desktop tool. Retain the simplified meeting layout.
